title: Ritual: omen favours
summary: Run Ritual tablets that tilt favours toward Omens and make deferring cheaper, then buy the omens with tribute. Since 0.5.5 a second Ritual Tablet adds an extra altar.

budget.build_needs: Kills revived Ritual waves; no boss requirement.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Listed among Ritual items (favours); 'of Omens' raises the chance a favour is an Omen.

nodes.name: Ancient Inscriptions
nodes.effect: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

atlas_master.alt: Jado T3 Partial Translations: randomly gain 0–40% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets.

claim.note: No master node targets Ritual; stronger tablet mods are the only lever. Our pick, not measured.

atlas_passives.name: Mysterious Rites
atlas_passives.effect: Rituals have a 8% chance to be the Queen's Ritual, which has more Favours, 10 additional Omens in the first set of Favours and an additional Idol

atlas_passives.name: Patient Devotion
atlas_passives.effect: Deferring Favours at Ritual Altars costs 50% reduced Tribute; Deferred Favours reappear 50% sooner

atlas_passives.name: Tempting Offers
atlas_passives.effect: Ritual Altars allow rerolling Favours 1 additional times

atlas_passives.name: Increased Tribute
atlas_passives.effect: Monsters Sacrificed at Ritual Altars grant 5% increased Tribute (a small node the tree repeats)

atlas_passives.name: Magnanimous Offerings
atlas_passives.effect: Rerolling Favours at Ritual Altars has 20% chance to be a Free Reroll

atlas_passives.name: Royal Lenience
atlas_passives.effect: Tribute already offered to the King may be used to Defer items; deferring this way costs 500% more Offered Tribute

mods.text: Ritual Favours in Map have (35–70)% increased chance to be Omens
Deferring Favours at Ritual Altars in Map costs (20–30)% reduced Tribute

claim.note: trade2 words this stat as 'increased'; the tablet rolls it as reduced.

mods.text: Monsters Sacrificed at Ritual Altars in Map grant (18–30)% increased Tribute
Ritual Altars in Map allow rerolling Favours (1–3) additional times

claim.note: No search button: trade2's closest stat reads 'an additional time' (120737942); that it is this mod is unconfirmed.

waystone.notes: More monsters to sacrifice should mean more tribute; no source measures it.

claim.note: Editorial; no source ties waystone totals to tribute.

steps: Allocate Mysterious Rites and Patient Devotion, then Tempting Offers and the Increased Tribute nodes.
Slot two Ritual Tablets (0.5.5: more than one adds an extra altar if possible), led by 'of Omens'.
Reroll for Omens; defer the ones you cannot afford yet and buy them when they return.
risks: Royal Lenience defers with tribute already offered to the King at 500% more cost — it trades away Audience progress.
Which Omens a favour list offers is random; the basket prices examples only.
